The type of acknowledgment. One of completed, persisted,
processed, received or stats.

The command ID that this ack refers to. Clients can use this field to
correlate the ack returned with the command being acknowledged.
This field will not be returned for acknowledgments that are conflated
(persisted acknowledgments for publish commands when AMPS has a
transaction log configured).

The reason for the status, most often returned with a failure status to
provide more detailed information about why the command failed.
